name: After Article 1
title: REPORT on the proposal for a regulation of the European Parliament and of the Council on a monitoring framework for resilient European forests
part_text: Article1a Strict protection of old-growth and primary forests This Regulation also lays down rules for collecting and making accessible information to support the effective and strict protection of all remaining primary and old-growth forests, which Member States shall ensure by the end of 2026 at the latest. Member States shall, in the meantime, put in place moratoriums on logging of all forests which are likely to be primary or old-growth to prevent their destruction before the identification, mapping and strict protection is complete.
